findings.description: 一応聞きには行った means he did go to ask, as a precaution or formality; half-heartedly attributes weak personal commitment.

findings.description: 不可避であるならば is conditional. Since the fate that awaited him was unavoidable states unavoidability as a premise.

contexts.japanese:

源次にとって、自分を待ち受ける運命が不可避であるならば、
その瞬間まで勤めを整然と果たすことがきっと美徳であったに違いない。
彼の心の奥底をうかがい知ることは、彼が自ら語らぬ限り、永遠に不可能だろう……。

contexts.WH: Genji must have considered it a virtue to systematically carry out his duty until the last moment, since the fate that awaited him was unavoidable.
contexts.MG:
Was he taking a philosophic view, or had he just accepted his fate?
Genji must have considered it a virtue that, when the fate that awaited him was unavoidable,
he carry out his duty systematically until the last moment.
The depths of his heart would probably remain hidden for all eternity, unless he spoke of them himself...

contexts.japanese:

せいぜい廊下を回り、窓の戸締りを確認するくらいだ。
だから、普段よりもだいぶ早く順路を回れるのだった。

findings.description: By looking that one omits at.

contexts.japanese:

熊沢さんの足首に刺し込まれたものは、少し浅かったのかもしれない。
抜けて倒れていた。
だから、その倒れたものを見て初めて俺は、これがナイフではなく、
杭のようなものであることを理解する。

杭のようなものであることを理解する。
contexts.WH: So, by looking that one that had fallen over, for the first time, I realized that it wasn't a knife, but something like a stake.
contexts.MG:
The one stuck into Doctor Nanjo's knee was still standing erect,
but the one that had been thrust into Kumasawa-san's ankle might have been a little shallower.
It had come out and fallen over.
So, by looking at the one that had fallen over, for the first time, I realized that it wasn't a knife,
but something like a stake.
contexts.UP:
The one that had been stuck into Doctor Nanjo's knee was still standing erect,
but the one that had been thrust into Kumasawa‐san's ankle might have been a little shallower.
It had come out and fallen over.
So, it was only when I saw that one that had fallen over, that for the first time, I realized that it wasn't a knife,
but something like a stake.
contexts.note: MG supplies looking at the fallen object; UP recasts the clause as when I saw it. Both repair the missing preposition.

MG.japanese:
だから、その倒れたものを見て初めて俺は、これがナイフではなく、杭のようなものであることを理解する。全長は多分、３０ｃｍあるかないか。
青銅とか鉄とか、そういう類のもので出来ているのだろう。手に触れずとも重みのあるものであることがわかる。
握りと、円錐部分で構成されていて、明らかに刺すための武器として作られたものだとわかる。
MG.translation: So, by looking at the one that had fallen over, for the first time, I realized that it wasn't a knife, but something like a stake. Its full length was probably about 30 centimeters. It was probably made out of bronze or iron or something of the sort. Even without touching it, I could tell it had some weight to it. It was composed of a grip and a cone-shaped part, and it was obviously made to be a piercing weapon.

UP.japanese:
だから、その倒れたものを見て初めて俺は、これがナイフではなく、杭のようなものであることを理解する。全長は多分、３０ｃｍあるかないか。

findings.description: 自分の胸が痛んだ describes Battler’s actual sympathetic pain; would cause anyone’s chest to hurt generalizes it into a hypothetical reaction.

contexts.japanese:
胸のど真ん中に、まるで吸血鬼に止めでも刺すみたいに、例の悪魔の杭がぶち込まれていた。
……あれだけ深々と胸に刺されたら、一体どこまで至ってしまうのか。
…想像しただけで自分の胸が痛んだ。
「…胸をえぐれは、第五の晩だったか」
contexts.japanesePC: …想像しただけで自分の胸が痛んだ。
contexts.japanesePS3:
胸のど真ん中に、まるで吸血鬼に止めでも刺すみたいに、例の悪魔の杭がぶち込まれていた。
……あれだけ深々と胸に刺されたら、一体どこまで至ってしまうのか。
…想像しただけで自分の胸が痛んだ。
「…胸をえぐれは、第五の晩だったか」
contexts.WH: ...Just imagining it would cause anyone's chest to hurt.
contexts.MG:
Right in the center of his chest, almost as though it had been stuck there to finish off a vampire, was one of those demon stakes from before.
...Exactly how far could it have reached after being stuck that deeply into his chest?
...Just imagining it would make anyone's chest hurt.
"...Wasn't gouging the chest...the fifth twilight?"
contexts.UP:
One of those demon stakes had been rammed right into the center of his chest, almost as though it had been stuck there to finish off a vampire.
......Exactly how far would it have reached after being stuck that deeply into his chest?
...My own chest hurt just imagining it.
"...Gouge the chest was the fifth twilight?"
contexts.note: MG generalizes the pain to anyone's chest. UP says My own chest hurt, preserving Battler's actual response.

MG.japanese: しかし、それより最初に目に入るのは、………部屋を入ってすぐのところにうつ伏せに倒れている郷田さんの遺体だった…。胸のど真ん中に、まるで吸血鬼に止めでも刺すみたいに、例の悪魔の杭がぶち込まれていた。……あれだけ深々と胸に刺されたら、一体どこまで至ってしまうのか。…想像しただけで自分の胸が痛んだ。

Right in the center of his chest, almost as though it had been stuck there to finish off a vampire, was one of those demon stakes from before. ...Exactly how far could it have reached after being stuck that deeply into his chest? ...Just imagining it would make anyone's chest hurt.

UP.japanese: しかし、それより最初に目に入るのは、………部屋を入ってすぐのところにうつ伏せに倒れている郷田さんの遺体だった…。胸のど真ん中に、まるで吸血鬼に止めでも刺すみたいに、例の悪魔の杭がぶち込まれていた。……あれだけ深々と胸に刺されたら、一体どこまで至ってしまうのか。…想像しただけで自分の胸が痛んだ。
UP.translation: But the thing that caught the eye before that... ......was Gohda‐san's body lying facedown right in front of the door... One of those demon stakes had been rammed right into the center of his chest, almost as though it had been stuck there to finish off a vampire. ......Exactly how far would it have reached after being stuck that deeply into his chest? ...My own chest hurt just imagining it.

findings.sourceReading: Merely imagining the penetration makes his own chest hurt.

findings.description: 額 specifies the forehead; head removes that anatomical precision.

contexts.japanese:
こんなことしてはいけないとわかっているのに、…彼女の顔をあげ、それを確認する。
……そして、自分の想像が完全に的中していることを、確認した。
紗音ちゃんの額にはぽっかりと穴が空き、そこから中身がどろりと溢れてくる。
それどころか、…その中身まで、…見えてしまう。
それを見て、俺はようやくしてはいけないことをしたことに気付いた。

After seeing that, I finally realized I was doing something wrong.

MG.japanese: 紗音ちゃんの額にはぽっかりと穴が空き、そこから中身がどろりと溢れてくる。それどころか、…その中身まで、…見えてしまう。それを見て、俺はようやくしてはいけないことをしたことに気付いた。慌てて目を背けたところで、今さら何の意味もなかっただろうが。
